edges.reason: onlyOwner compares msg.sender with owner; the whole privileged surface depends on this caller controlled value.
Constructor derives owner/admins/advertising from msg.sender, seeding all privileges.
doInvest uses msg.sender for caps, registration and referral checks.
getMyDividends pays msg.sender, so the caller is the recipient of the outbound call.
Payment interval and payment time use now, a miner manipulable timestamp.
calcDividends depends on now.sub(paymentTime) for accrual.
currDay is computed solely from now and startTimestamp.
nextWave stamps waveStartup with now.
doInvest records payment times and emits now during investment.
getMyDividends performs msg.sender.transfer while state has already been touched in the same external flow.
getMyDividends asserts setPaymentTime before paying out.
getMyDividends rolls the wave when balance is insufficient.
getMyDividends computes the payout via calcDividends.
doInvest refunds excess to msg.sender before writing investment state.
doInvest sends the advertising commission before investor bookkeeping.
doInvest sends the admins commission before investor bookkeeping.
doInvest credits referrer and reinvest dividends through addInvestment.
doInvest registers new investors through newInvestor.
doInvest queries calcDividends for automatic reinvest.
doInvest records the investment in rapid growth protection.
doInvest asks private entrance for the caller's cap.
doInvest asks rapid growth protection for the remaining allowance.
doInvest increments investmentsNumber without overflow protection.
doInvest accumulates investment += referalBonus unchecked.
doInvest accumulates investment += dividends unchecked.
addInvestment performs raw += on the stored investment value.
saveInvestment performs raw += on dailyTotalInvestment.
calcDividends multiplies and divides user scaled values without SafeMath.
calcDividends fetches the current tier percent.
dailyPercent copies the selected percent struct to memory.
getMyDividends loads the caller record in memory.
calcDividends loads the investor record in memory.
calcDividends applies the memory percentage multiplication.
mmul mirrors the storage-based mul calculation.
init starts the rapid growth protection window.
init is guarded by onlyOwner.

setAdminsAddress is guarded by onlyOwner.

getMyDividends measures the payment interval with SafeMath.sub.

normalization_plan.reason: Referrer address only exists to credit referral bonuses inside doInvest.
Investor address is only used to look up the record whose dividends are computed.
Owner supplied address is written to the advertising state variable and nothing else.
Owner supplied address is written to the admins state variable and nothing else.
Address array is forwarded straight into the whitelist granting routine.
Owner timestamp only initializes rapid growth and private entrance windows.
External storage address is only stored in the private entrance struct during init.
Target address is forwarded directly to the disqualification routine.
Amount parameter is only summed into an existing investor balance.
Address parameter only selects the balance that is updated.
Scratch amount used to cap, credit and register the investment inside doInvest.
Tracks the original msg.value for commission and excess splitting within doInvest.
Intermediate daily allowance value only consumed by the doInvest capping logic.
Intermediate private entrance cap only consumed by the doInvest capping logic.
Computed refund value flows directly into the external transfer to the caller.
Auto-reinvest amount only used to grow the investment in doInvest.
Boolean branch selector local to the doInvest registration flow.
Bonus value is immediately credited to the referrer through addInvestment.
Bonus value flows into the unchecked accumulation of the new investment.
Dividend value is the payload of the external transfer in getMyDividends.
Contract balance is only used to select the percentage tier.
Day index local is only produced by and consumed with the rapid growth protection accounting.
